plan.title: Rewire migrate and install task entrypoints off Python on the consumer path

narratives.Description: Consumer migrate and install tasks still invoke uv run python for migrate_preflight, migrate_vbrief, and legacy run upgrade. This story replaces consumer-path invocations with native deft verbs where TS handlers exist, documents the #2013 migrate_vbrief holdout if it must remain, and removes install upgrade's Python run shim from the default consumer surface.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
Audit tasks/migrate.yml and tasks/install.yml for uv run python entrypoints; rewire migrate:preflight and any TS-backed paths to node bin.js / deft verbs.
For migrate:vbrief (#2013 holdout), either gate behind explicit contributor path or leave documented carve-out; rewire install upgrade off scripts/run.py.
Add or extend tests and run task verify:no-task-runtime scoped to these files.
narratives.UserStory: As a consumer running migrate or install tasks, I want those verbs to call deft only, so that my deposit path does not require Python for standard lifecycle operations.

items.title: Given tasks/migrate.yml on the consumer deposit path, when scanned, then every entrypoint except the documented #2013 migrate_vbrief holdout routes through deft/node rather than uv run python.

narrative.Acceptance: Given tasks/migrate.yml on the consumer deposit path, when scanned, then every entrypoint except the documented #2013 migrate_vbrief holdout routes through deft/node rather than uv run python.
